notReleased.package.json: the private npm workspace root: it installs packages/ts as a workspace and takes @polyspec/ordered-json from its GitHub release through overrides
notReleased.composer.json: the private Composer root: it installs packages/php as a path repository and takes polyspec/ordered-json from its GitHub release zip
notReleased.packages/rust/Cargo.toml: the Cargo workspace of the Rust crates, no package of its own
notReleased.packages/rust/case-clock/Cargo.toml: a test support crate of the Rust client (publish = false)
notReleased.packages/rust/case-database/Cargo.toml: a test support crate of the Rust client (publish = false)
notReleased.packages/rust/testcase/Cargo.toml: a test support crate of the Rust client (publish = false)
notReleased.packages/rust/tests/Cargo.toml: the integration tests of the Rust client (publish = false)
notReleased.benchmarks/rust/Cargo.toml: the benchmark crate of the Rust client
notReleased.packages/rust/testing/interfaces/Cargo.t: the interface check crate of the Rust client
notReleased.packages/ts/testing/interfaces/typescrip: the TypeScript compiler of the interface check of the TypeScript client
notReleased.tests/go.mod: the Go module of the runners, physical tests and tool programs under tests/, which go.work joins to packages/go
notReleased.examples/go.mod: the Go module of the examples and their output test, which go.work joins to packages/go
notReleased.tests/release-consumer/npm/package.json: the npm consumer project of the release archives
notReleased.tests/release-consumer/composer/composer: the Composer consumer project of the release archives
